**Subject:** Invitation to Meet and Discuss Alignment Nashville Audit Proposal  

Dear [Recipient’s Name],  

On behalf of **Alignment Nashville**, we would like to extend a formal invitation to meet in person to further discuss our **audit proposal** and explore potential next steps in collaboration. We value the opportunity to connect directly and ensure that our proposal fully aligns with your goals and expectations.  

Please let us know if any of the following dates and times work well with your schedule:  

- **Friday, October 24** — before noon  
- **Wednesday, October 29** — anytime  
- **Thursday, October 30** — between 11:00 AM and 3:00 PM  

The meeting will take place at:  
**FirstBank of Nashville**  
1221 Broadway, Suite 1300  
Nashville, TN 37203  

If none of the above times are convenient, we would be happy to accommodate an alternative date that better suits your availability.  

We look forward to the opportunity to meet with you and discuss how Alignment Nashville can best support your objectives.  

Warm regards,  
**[Your Full Name]**  
[Your Title]  
**Alignment Nashville**  
[Your Phone Number] | [Your Email Address]  

---

Would you like me to make it sound slightly **more corporate** (formal, like a proposal follow-up) or **more relational** (friendly and partnership-oriented)? I can tailor the tone either way.

**Subject:** Follow-Up on Meeting Date  

Hello Candice,  

Thank you so much for your quick response. I really appreciate it.  

Whenever you have confirmation, please let us know if **Thursday, the 30th** will work for your team. We’re looking forward to finalizing the details and appreciate your coordination.  

Wishing you a wonderful weekend ahead!  

Warm regards,  
**Bethany**
